
```{r}
#| label: baseline-hist
#| fig-height: 4
kept <- trl %>% filter(rejected == 0, !is.na(baseline_sd_uv))
if (nrow(kept) == 0) {
  cat("\n\nNo surviving trials to describe.\n\n")
} else {
  hp <- ggplot(kept, aes(x = baseline_sd_uv)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = alz_blue, colour = NA) +
    labs(x = "Pre-stimulus SD (uV)", y = "Trials",
         subtitle = "Every surviving trial, all subjects pooled") +
    alz_theme()
  print(hp)
}
```
